chunks: We shall make easy for you the way of ease.

key_terms.لِلْيُسْرَىٰ: To the ease / The way of ease (referring to Paradise or ease in religion)
key_terms.نُيَسِّرُكَ: We shall make easy for you (verb form indicating facilitation)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'We shall make easy for you the way of ease' mean in Surah Al-A'la?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently understood as a divine promise to facilitate the Prophet Muhammad's journey toward the highest degree of proximity to God, often linked to the concept of *Tayyibah* (purity) or the ease of receiving revelation. It underscores the divine support granted to the Ahl al-Bayt in navigating the spiritual path, ensuring that the burden of prophethood is eased through divine grace and guidance.
